scope: Process deadline enforcement only; no changes to native scheduling, imported blocks, trace selection or storage assertions

focused_regression.command: PYTHONPATH=src:tests:. python -m pytest -q tests/test_connected_runtime_deadline.py tests/test_memory_controller_runtime_experiment.py -k 'deadline or native_runtime_' --junitxml=build/runtime-deadline-review.xml

failure_fixed: A successful or failing child first observed after the wall deadline was previously accepted by the monitor without an explicit timeout flag. Both live callers and later retained-clock validation now reject late completion while preserving the actual reaped exit code.
acceptance_rule: Elapsed observation must be finite and nonnegative, strictly less than the positive integer recorded wall limit, with explicit_wall_timeout_reached exactly false. At or after the limit the run is incomplete.
monitor_checks: natural exit during deadline kill preserves real code
caller_checks: late clock exit 0 rejected before native result parsing
late transaction exit 0 rejected before native result parsing
safe retained clock result rejected after deadline
too-fast retained clock result rejected after deadline

comparison_baseline.scope: The same committed parent-wrapper small native proof. Its retained earlier comparison to c985ff remains historical; this new run compares directly with faccd37.
